description: A modest village market selling basic weapons, travel gear, and recovery pills.
A cultivator market where spirit stones buy low-grade treasures and breakthrough aids.
A high-value auction house with rarer defensive treasures and flying swords.
The academy's outfitter, selling mortal-grade arms and recovery pills to new disciples.
A weather-beaten trader swapping mortal gear and pelts to hunters heading uphill.
The valley sect's gate-market, selling low-spirit gear and breakthrough aids to outer disciples.
A quiet monastery hall selling mind-clearing amulets, talismans, and tonic pills.
A bustling port bazaar where spirit stones buy cultivator gear and breakthrough elixirs.
The kingdom's grand market, trading mid-spirit arms and elixirs for spirit stones.
A black market dealing in high-spirit arms and lifespan-extending elixirs.
An exchange on the gate array's threshold, selling earth-grade treasures and breakthrough pills.
The continent's soul market, trading heaven-grade relics and immortality pellets for spirit stones.
Broker Lan's open-air stalls: hunter manuals, trail pills, and whatever the deepwood yielded this week.
Quiet bids under pearl gauze: sea-route manuals, deep-sea salves, and pills graded for the long cultivation tracks.
